The memo accurately reflects all key financial terms present in the source document. All specific dates (April 10, 2024; September 28, 2022; June 28, 2024; July 1, 2024), party names (ScanSource, Inc.; JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.), roles (Administrative Agent, Swingline Lender, Issuing Bank), and covenant terms regarding the CDOR cessation and suspension of rights are properly supported by the source document. The memo appropriately indicates "N/A" for financial terms not disclosed in this particular document (deal size, interest rates, maturity dates, etc.) rather than fabricating information.

ANSWER: NO
MISSING_TERMS: None

The memo captures all the key financial terms available in the source document. The source document is a Suspension of Rights Agreement that contains limited financial details by nature - it's focused on temporarily suspending access to CAD CDOR loans rather than establishing new credit terms. The memo appropriately notes "N/A" for terms like deal size, price, interest rate specifics, and maturity date because these are not provided in this particular document, which references but doesn't repeat the terms of the underlying September 28, 2022 credit agreement. All material terms that are present in the source document - including the key dates (April 10, 2024 agreement date, June 28, 2024 CDOR cessation, July 1, 2024 suspension effective date), party names, covenant terms related to the suspension, and indemnification obligations - are properly captured in the memo.
